### When Good and Evil are Confused
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/when-good-and-evil-are-confused
Passage: Isaiah 5:20
Points:
- Greed led ancient landowners to exploit the vulnerable, bringing eventual ruin upon their estates.
- An obsessive pursuit of pleasure and entertainment blinds people to God's presence and works.
- The core spiritual crisis of Judah was an inverted moral order that called evil good and good evil.
- Societies that openly celebrate wickedness invite divine judgment and cannot endure.
- Believers and public leaders bear a duty to uphold righteousness and call others to repentance.

### Power Point - Dec. 12, 2006
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-dec-12-2006-1456921.html
Passage: Isaiah 5:20
Points:
- Modern culture reflexively favors novelty, wrongly assuming ancient biblical standards are out of date.
- Rather than restrictive rules meant to ruin joy, God's commandments are absolute guides to genuine flourishing.
- People frequently resist divine commands because they want to define acceptable behavior on their own terms.
- Obeying God's directives displays real peace, joy, and satisfaction to a culture confused about good and evil.
